stories.title: Two Houston game rooms could be shut down permanently over alleged illegal gambling
stories.summary: Harris County is suing to permanently close two Houston game rooms over alleged illegal gambling and bar future game rooms at both properties.

stories.title: 'It's just a dumping ground' | Neighbors say they've complained for months about discarded trash and debris along a Houston street
stories.summary: Furniture, tires, car parts, and other illegally dumped debris line the connector between Buffalo Speedway and Holmes Road.

stories.title: High-speed chase through Houston ends in Heights-area park
stories.summary: Houston police chased a truck through a busy shopping center and a park before the driver crashed into a tree.

stories.title: Texans vs. Colts tonight: Roof open at Reliant Stadium for Thursday Night Football
stories.summary: The Texans announced the roof will be open as they prepare to face the Colts on a short week following a loss to the Browns.

stories.title: Conroe ISD lifts lockdowns after threatening call is determined to be a hoax
stories.summary: A hoax phone threat prompted lockdowns at two Conroe high school campuses Thursday. All students and staff are safe, and normal operations have resumed.

stories.title: Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa says she talked border with Trump, will roll back Abbott executive orders on H-1B visas, THC
stories.summary: In an interview with The Texas Tribune, the Austin Democrat discussed her first call with Trump, and the future of school vouchers.

stories.title: Houston-area school district restricts network access after attempted cybersecurity intrusion
stories.summary: According to a statement posted on the district website, schools remained open, but visitor access was restricted. It's unclear what caused the disruption.

stories.title: Former Texas lab CEO gets prison time for falsifying wastewater tests
stories.summary: A former Texas wastewater lab CEO was sentenced to prison and fined $250,000 after falsified tests concealed pollution limit violations for years.

stories.title: Unique Sugar Land mansion on three acres for sale
stories.summary: Including the two-level primary suite, the home has six bedrooms, seven full bathrooms, two half-baths and a four-car garage.

stories.title: Execution set for Houston man who killed jeweler in million-dollar diamond heist
stories.summary: Reinaldo Dennes, now 70, would be the ninth and final Texas inmate executed in 2026.

stories.title: Former Texas political candidate says country club voted to expel him
stories.summary: In a statement, he says River Crest Country Club asked him to resign his membership after his controversial posts about the University of Texas in September.

stories.title: Family questions deadly Crosby road rage shooting involving constable's office dispatcher
stories.summary: The family of a 35-year-old man killed in an apparent road rage shooting in Crosby is mourning his death and questioning why the confrontation turned deadly.
